for name in ['host','client']:
 if not (base/name).exists():subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/ssh-keygen','-q','-t','ed25519','-N','','-f',str(base/name)],check=True)
s=socket.socket();s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));port=s.getsockname()[1];s.close()
config=f'''Port {port}
ListenAddress 127.0.0.1
HostKey {base}/host
PidFile {base}/sshd.pid

KbdInteractiveAuthentication no

AllowTcpForwarding no
X11Forwarding no

(base/'sshd_config').write_text(config)
p=subprocess.run(['/usr/sbin/sshd','-t','-f',str(base/'sshd_config')],capture_output=True,text=True);print('config-check',p.returncode,p.stderr,flush=True)

if p.returncode:server.terminate();server.wait(timeout=5);raise SystemExit(1)
print('ready',json.dumps({'server_pid':server.pid,'port':port}),flush=True)

if '--evaluate' in sys.argv:
 try:
